{{Quote|What is it this time? Strange pheromones? An open hatch? Someone's pet mynock on the loose?|H449-B7 to a Verpine technician, shortly before being murdered by Jaina Solo|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>}}
'''H449-B7''', or '''Aitch''', was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] who was a part of a group assigned to secure [[Nickel One]] after the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. He was assigned to guard [[Sangi]], a technician, who was working in a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojection]] station, but he was lured out of the station by a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] who was working with [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. As soon as he stepped out of the holoprojector booth, Solo ambushed and killed him, shooting him in the head.
